https://www.skinnytaste.com/cottage-chee.instructions:
Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil.
Heat a large skillet over medium heat. When hot, add the ground turkey, Italian seasoning, garlic powder, salt and black pepper. Cook 5 to 6 minutes, breaking up until cooked through. Remove from heat and transfer meat to a plate. Wipe the skillet.
While the turkey is cooking, cook the rigatoni according to package instructions to al dente reserving ½ cup of pasta water before draining for thinning out sauce later and set aside.
Heat the skillet over medium heat and add 1 ½ teaspoons of olive oil, onion, garlic and red pepper flakes. Cook 3 to 4 minutes until onions are translucent.
Add the tomato paste and cook 2 to 3 minutes and make sure onions and garlic are well coated in tomato paste. It will begin to turn a darker red, and that is what you want. De-glaze with bone broth, stir well, and remove from heat.
Add cottage cheese and milk to a large blender and blend for 15 to 30 seconds until smooth throughout. Add the tomato sauce to the blender and the parmesan cheese and blend until smooth.
Pour it back into the skillet adding some water to the blender and pouring it into the sauce to get it all out, and stir over low heat until cohesive. If needed, add some reserved pasta water 1-2 tablespoons at a time, to get the right texture.
Drain the pasta then add it to the sauce with the ground meat and stir. Top off with additional grated parmesan and fresh basil. Enjoy!

https://pinchofyum.com/roasted-sweet-pot.instructions:
Prep Sweet Potatoes
Preheat the oven to 425 degrees. Brush or drizzle all sides of the sweet potatoes with oil; place face-down on a sheet pan. Sprinkle top side with salt.
Roast Sweet Potatoes
Bake for 20 minutes. Use a spatula to gently lift one and check for doneness (you want to preserve that caramelized surface area). Bake for an additional 10-15 minutes as needed to cook through and caramelize the bottom side.
Cook Chicken
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium high heat. Add the onion; sauté until soft and fragrant. Add chicken and taco seasoning; brown, breaking up with a spatula, until cooked through.
Sauce Chicken
Add salsa and salt to the chicken; sauté for another 1-2 minutes. Cover to keep warm until you’re ready to serve.
Sauce
Whisk all sauce ingredients until smooth. Taste and adjust.
Toppings
Cut avocado, cilantro, onions, nuts or seeds for topping.
Serve
I stack in this order: sweet potato, then sauce, then chicken, then toppings. Possibly more sauce on top. So, so good.

https://www.budgetbytes.com/creamy-garli.description: A simple pan sauce saves the day in this quick and easy Creamy Mushroom Chicken made with juicy thighs, mushrooms, garlic, Parmesan, and half-and-half!
https://www.budgetbytes.com/creamy-garli.instructions:
Gather and prep your ingredients
Season both sides of the chicken thighs with salt and pepper.
Brown the chicken
Heat a large skillet over medium, then add the cooking oil. Swirl the oil to coat the bottom of the skillet. Add the chicken thighs to the skillet and cook until golden brown on each side and cooked through (about 5 minutes per side). Remove the chicken to a plate and cover with foil to keep warm.
Saute
Add the minced garlic to the skillet and sauté for one minute, or just until the garlic softens. Now add the mushrooms and sauté for about 5-7 minutes more, or until the mushrooms have wilted.
Add the broth
Pour the chicken broth into the skillet and stir to dissolve all the browned bits off the bottom.
Add the cream
Add the half and half to the skillet and bring it up to a simmer. Turn the heat down to medium-low and simmer the liquid, stirring often, for about five minutes. Stir in the Parmesan until it has melted in.
Warm through
Taste the sauce and season with salt and pepper if needed. Add the chicken back to the skillet, drench with sauce, and heat over low until warmed through. The internal temperature of the chicken should reach 165℉ before serving.
Serve
Top with fresh parsley for garnish, if desired. Enjoy!

ingredients: 1 1/2 cups fresh corn kernels (about 2 ears, or frozen, thawed and patted dry)
2 tablespoons chopped fresh parsley or cilantro
1 teaspoon chipotle powder (or 1/2 tsp smoked paprika for milder flavor)
1 1/2 cups fresh corn kernels (about 2 ears, or frozen, thawed and patted dry)

https://www.paleorunningmomma.com/zucchi.instructions:
Shred the zucchini using a box grater. I used the small setting for the photos, however the large setting works as well.
Place the zucchini in a clean kitchen towel and squeeze very well until almost no liquid comes out. This is the secret to crispy fritters!
You should have about 2-2 1/2 packed cups after squeezing.
In a large bowl combine the squeezed zucchini, corn, scallions, and parsley. Then add the egg and mix well. Add the almond flour, tapioca or arrowroot, baking powder, salt, garlic powder, onion powder and black pepper. Mix until everything is evenly coated, then let the mixture sit 5 minutes.
Heat a large nonstick or cast iron skillet over medium heat. Add enough oil to lightly coat the pan. Scoop about 1/4 cup mixture for each fritter and flatten gently to about 1/2 inch thickness.
Cook 3-4 minutes first side, flip carefully, then cook 3 minutes on the second side. They should be deep golden brown. Transfer to a cooling rack while cooking remaining batches.
For the dipping sauce, whisk all ingredients together until smooth. Serve warm with the dipping sauce and enjoy!

Cook the Chicken
Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add chicken and cook 3 to 4 minutes per side, until browned, it does not need to be cooked through. Transfer to a plate.

Serve over mashed potatoes or buttered noodles.

https://www.budgetbytes.com/salisbury-st.description: Homemade Salisbury Steak with a rich mushroom gravy is a quick, simple, and hearty weeknight dinner that will fill even the biggest of appetites!
https://www.budgetbytes.com/salisbury-st.instructions:
Salisbury Steak Directions
Gather and prepare all ingredients.
Mince the onion
Finely mince about ½ cup of the onion and slice the remainder of the onion. The minced onion will go in the ground beef mixture; the rest will be used for the gravy.
Shape the meat
Add the ground beef, minced onion, breadcrumbs, egg, 1 Tbsp of the Worcestershire sauce (the remainder will go in the gravy), Italian seasoning, ½ teaspoon of salt, and ¼ teaspoon of pepper to a large bowl. Use your hands to mix the ingredients until they are evenly combined. Divide the mixture into four equal parts and shape each into a flattened oval.
Brown the patties
Add the cooking oil to a large skillet and heat over medium. Once the skillet is hot, add the shaped beef patties and cook for about 5 minutes on each side, or until they are well browned on each side. Transfer the cooked patties to a clean plate.
Mushroom Gravy Directions
Brown the veggies
While the beef patties are cooking, slice the mushrooms. After removing the beef from the skillet, add the sliced mushrooms and the remaining sliced onion, along with the remaining salt and pepper. Continue to cook the mushrooms and onions over medium heat until they are soft. Allow the moisture to release from the onions and mushrooms, which will help dissolve any browned bits on the bottom of the skillet as you stir, for about 5 minutes.
Make a roux
Once the mushrooms and onions have softened and most of the moisture has evaporated off the bottom of the skillet, add the butter and flour. Continue to stir and cook for about two minutes. The flour and butter will form a paste and begin to coat the bottom of the skillet.
Simmer the gravy
Add the beef broth and remaining Worcestershire sauce to the skillet. Stir to dissolve the flour into the broth, making sure to dissolve any flour that is stuck to the bottom of the skillet. Allow the broth to come up to a simmer (still over medium heat), stirring often. Once it reaches a simmer, it will thicken into a gravy.
Serve
Once the gravy is simmering, add the beef patties back to the skillet with the broth, mushrooms, and onions. Spoon the gravy over top and continue to simmer the beef in the gravy for an additional five minutes. The patties should reach an internal temperature of 160°F before serving. Taste the gravy and adjust the salt and pepper to your liking. Enjoy!

ingredients: 1 ¼-½ lbs boneless skinless chicken breasts or thighs (I used chicken breasts )
¼ cup BBQ sauce (I like Stubb's or Primal Kitchen)
1 bag (16 oz) frozen sweet corn kernels (defrosted )
1 15 oz can black beans (drained and rinsed )
2 cups cooked rice (or half rice + half cauliflower rice)
2 cups black bean and corn salad

Preheat the oven to 400°F. Spread the sweet potato chunks on a parchment-lined baking sheet, spray with avocado oil, and season with salt, pepper, and garlic powder. Roast for 20–30 minutes, stirring halfway through, until tender and lightly caramelized.

Cook chicken
Pat the chicken dry and season both sides with the smoked paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, and black pepper. Coat chicken
Let the chicken rest for 5 minutes, then chop into bite-sized pieces. Toss with the BBQ sauce until evenly coated.

In a small bowl, whisk together the Greek yogurt, BBQ sauce, milk, ranch seasoning, apple cider vinegar, and salt until smooth and creamy. Taste and adjust seasoning as needed.

If needed, warm the cooked rice or cauliflower rice according to package directions. Divide the rice between four bowls, then top with the BBQ chicken, roasted sweet potatoes, black bean and corn salad, cherry tomatoes, shredded cabbage, and sliced avocado. Drizzle generously with the BBQ ranch and finish with fresh cilantro, pickled red onions (if using), and a squeeze of fresh lime.

https://www.skinnytaste.com/ratatouille-.description: This Ratatouille Lasagna is a noodle-less, high-protein vegetarian lasagna made with layers of summer vegetables, cottage cheese, and mozzarella.

ingredients: 2 cups shredded part-skim mozzarella cheese ((7 ½ ounces) )
⅓ cup grated Parmesan cheese ((1 ½ oz) )
½ tablespoon extra virgin olive oil
28 ounce can crushed tomatoes (I love Tuttorosso)
⅛ teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes
½ cup chopped fresh basil leaves (divided)
1 small zucchini (about 7 ounces, sliced ⅛th inch thick lengthwise)
1 small yellow squash (about 7 ounces, sliced ⅛th inch thick lengthwise)
1 medium eggplant (sliced ¼ inch thick lengthwise, 9 ounces total)
2 cups shredded part-skim mozzarella cheese ((7 ½ ounces) )
⅓ cup grated Parmesan cheese ((1 ½ oz) )
½ tablespoon extra virgin olive oil
28 ounce can crushed tomatoes (I love Tuttorosso)
⅛ teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes
½ cup chopped fresh basil leaves (divided)
1 small zucchini (about 7 ounces, sliced ⅛th inch thick lengthwise)
1 small yellow squash (about 7 ounces, sliced ⅛th inch thick lengthwise)
1 medium eggplant (sliced ¼ inch thick lengthwise, 9 ounces total)
https://www.skinnytaste.com/ratatouille-.instructions:
Preheat oven to 375°F. Drain the cottage cheese in a mesh sieve while preparing the vegetables.
In a large non-stick skillet add olive oil and sauté onions and garlic over medium heat 2 to 3 minutes, until fragrant. Add 1 teaspoon salt, black pepper, crushed tomatoes, red pepper flakes, bay leaf, thyme, half of the basil, red and yellow bell pepper and cook another 8 to 10 minutes, partially covered on medium-low heat.
Meanwhile, spray a large nonstick grill pan with oil and grill the zucchini, squash and eggplant 2 to 3 minutes on each side. Set aside on paper towels.
In a medium bowl, mix the drained cottage cheese, half of the mozzarella, Parmesan cheese, remaining basil and egg until thoroughly combined, then season with the ½ teaspoon of salt and ¼ teaspoon black pepper.
Assemble the dish: Spread ½ cup of the sauce to the bottom of a glass 11 x 7 ½ x 3 inch casserole dish. Layer the eggplant, overlapping as needed to make the first layer, coming up a little on the sides. Top with half of the cheese mixture, 1 cup sauce then add the layer of zucchini. Top with another cup of sauce, the remaining cheese mixture, then the yellow squash. Finish with the remaining sauce and cover with foil, and bake 25 minutes until the vegetables start to get tender. Uncover, and bake 30 minutes more until the liquid dries up and the vegetables are tender. Top with the remaining mozzarella cheese and bake 10 more minutes, until the cheese melts.
Remove from the oven and let it rest 10 to 15 minutes before cutting. Slice into 4 pieces.

ingredients: 2 Tablespoons red wine vinegar or lemon juice
4 slices cooked bacon or turkey bacon
½ cup pickled red onions or fresh red onions (sliced)
¾ cup fresh basil leaves (finely chopped (lightly packed))
½ cup plain full-fat Greek yogurt

Marinate chicken: Whisk vinegar, oil, garlic powder, thyme, oregano, salt and pepper in a small bowl until well combined. Place chicken in a shallow dish or 1-gallon sealable plastic bag. Add the marinade, toss to coat and refrigerate for at least 1 hour or up to 12 hours.

Serve: Drizzle each salad with 2–3 Tablespoons dressing, then add more if needed. Serve immediately and enjoy!

Gather and prepare all ingredients. Preheat the oven to 350°F and grease an 8x10-inch casserole dish with nonstick cooking spray and set it aside.
Dice the chicken into small pieces and pat dry with paper towels. Season the chicken evenly with salt and pepper.
Brown the chicken
Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Once hot, add the cubed chicken in an even layer. Sear in batches if needed. Cook undisturbed for 3 minutes, then flip and cook for an additional 3 minutes. Remove the chicken from the skillet and place it on paper towels to drain. Set aside.
Make the sauce
Turn the heat to medium and add the butter, hot sauce, garlic powder, onion powder, and cream cheese. Stir until the cream cheese has melted, about 2 minutes.
Add the cheese
Add 1 cup of cheddar cheese and the diced chicken back into the pan. Fold until it melts and combine for about 1 minute. Then turn off the heat.
Fill the peppers
Place the bell peppers in the casserole dish, cut side up. Fill each pepper with the buffalo chicken filling.
Bake the peppers, uncovered, in the oven for 20 minutes. Remove them from the oven, then evenly top with the remaining cheddar cheese and blue cheese.
Finish and serve
Place them back in the oven and continue cooking for an additional 15 minutes. Top with green onions, then enjoy!

Simmer Until Creamy: Pour in the broth and bring to a simmer. Cook, stirring occasionally, until the orzo is tender and most of the liquid is absorbed, about 10 to 12 minutes.

Toast the Breadcrumbs: Meanwhile, in a medium skillet, melt the butter over medium heat. Add the panko, garlic powder, and salt. Cook, stirring often, until the breadcrumbs are golden brown and crisp. Remove from the heat and stir in the Parmesan cheese. Set aside.
Stir in the Cream and Parmesan: Reduce the heat to low. Stir in the heavy cream, Parmesan cheese, and basil. Cook until creamy and well combined. Taste and season with additional salt, if needed.
Garnish and Serve: Spoon the orzo into bowls and top with the parmesan garlic breadcrumbs, fresh basil, and extra Parmesan cheese. Serve warm.

ingredients: 1 (14.5 ounce) can canned petite diced tomatoes (with juice)
½ cup long grain white rice (uncooked)
½ cup shredded mozzarella cheese (or cheddar cheese, optional)

https://www.spendwithpennies.com/stuffed.instructions:
Preheat the oven to 350°F. Grease a 9x13-inch casserole dish.
Cut off the tops of the bell peppers. Discard the stems, finely chop the tops, and set aside for the sauce. Core the peppers, discarding the membranes and seeds.
To cook the peppers, bring a large pot of water to a boil. Cook the peppers for 5 minutes and then drain them well. Alternatively, air fry the peppers at 400°F for 5 minutes.
For the filling, heat a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add the ground beef, Italian sausage, diced onion, and minced garlic. Cook, breaking it up with a spoon, until no pink remains. Drain the fat.
Add diced tomatoes with their juices, water, Worcestershire sauce, rice, the diced pepper tops, Italian seasoning, and ¼ teaspoon each salt and black pepper.
Bring the mixture to a boil, reduce the heat to a low simmer, and cover. Cook until the rice is tender, about 15 to 20 minutes, adding more water if needed. Remove from the heat and stir in ½ cup of the marinara. Taste and season with more salt and pepper if desired.
Place 1 ½ cups of marinara sauce in the bottom of the prepared baking dish. Add the peppers, cut-side-up, and divide the rice mixture evenly into the peppers. Spoon the remaining marinara sauce over the top.
Cover tightly with foil, bake for 35 minutes.
Carefully remove the foil and spoon the sauce from the bottom of the dish over the peppers. Top with cheese (if using) and bake uncovered for an additional 10 to 12 minutes or until the peppers are tender and the cheese is fully melted.
Rest for 5 minutes before serving.

Cook the bacon. Preheat oven to 350°F. Cook bacon until mostly crispy. Transfer to a plate, leaving about 2 tablespoons fat.
Sauté the veggies. Add onion + red bell pepper and cook 5–6 minutes until soft and slightly caramelized. Add garlic and cook 1 more minute.

https://www.loveandlemons.com/crispy-ric.description: This crispy rice salad recipe is a fresh, delicious lunch or side dish! It features my easy sesame ginger dressing over sheet pan crispy rice, peanuts, fresh herbs, and veggies. I love topping mine with chili crisp for a spicy pop.

ingredients: 3 cups cooked and cooled rice, leftover rice is best
3 cups cooked and cooled rice, leftover rice is best
https://www.loveandlemons.com/crispy-ric.instructions:
Make the crispy rice: Preheat the oven to 400°F and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Place the rice on the baking sheet. Drizzle with the sesame oil and tamari, toss to coat, and spread evenly on the baking sheet. Roast for 10 minutes, then toss. Roast for another 12 to 16 minutes, or until the rice is lightly crisp and golden brown. Toss with the salt and set aside. The rice will continue to crisp up as it cools.
Prep the salad: In a large bowl, toss the cucumbers with the rice vinegar, sugar, and salt. Set aside for 15 minutes to marinate.
Meanwhile, make the sesame ginger dressing: In a small bowl, whisk together the tahini, sesame oil, rice vinegar, tamari, ginger, and maple syrup. The dressing should have a creamy, drizzleable consistency. If it’s too thick, add water, 1 tablespoon at a time, to loosen it.
Divide the cucumbers among 4 serving bowls, leaving any excess water behind. Divide the edamame, avocado, scallions, and peanuts among the bowls and drizzle with some of the dressing. Top with the crispy rice and garnish with mint. Drizzle with chili crisp, season to taste, and serve with the remaining dressing on the side.

ingredients: 12 ounces boneless pork chops (or pork tenderloin, cut into ½-inch strips)
⅔ cup pineapple chunks (reserve juice for sauce)
⅓ cup pineapple juice ( from pineapple chunks above, or orange juice)
¼ cup less sodium soy sauce

https://www.spendwithpennies.com/pork-st.instructions:
Season pork with salt & pepper and toss with 1 tablespoon cornstarch. Refrigerate for 15 minutes (while you prepare the remaining ingredients).
To make the sauce in a small bowl, whisk together water, pineapple juice, soy sauce, brown sugar, sriracha, and sesame oil.
Heat 1 tablespoon of oil over medium-high heat in a large pan. Stir fry pork in small batches until browned (it does not need to be cooked all the way through). Remove from pan and set aside.
Add remaining oil to the pan if needed and add vegetables. Stir-fry until tender-crisp, about 3 to 4 minutes. Add garlic and ginger and cook for 30 seconds or until fragrant. Remove the vegetables from the pan.
Add the stir fry sauce and bring to a simmer.
Combine 1 tablespoon cornstarch with 2 tablespoons water and whisk into the boiling sauce a little bit at a time to reach the desired consistency.
Add pork, pineapple and vegetables back to the pan and let simmer 2 minutes or just until heated through.
Serve with rice or noodles.

ingredient_groups.purpose: For the blackened seasoning (yields about 2 teaspoons):

https://www.gimmesomeoven.com/black-and-.instructions:
Make the blackened seasoning. In a small bowl, whisk together all of the seasoning ingredients until evenly combined. Set aside.
Make the blue cheese sauce. In a small bowl, stir together the mayo, crumbled blue cheese, Dijon, red wine vinegar, garlic powder, and black pepper. Taste and adjust — it should be creamy, tangy, and nicely bold.
Cook the bacon. Cook the bacon in a skillet over medium heat until crisp. Transfer to a paper towel-lined plate and set aside.
Mix and shape the patties. In a bowl, gently combine the ground beef, Worcestershire sauce, salt, and pepper. Mix just until combined, then form into 4 patties about 3/4-inch thick. Press a slight indent into the center of each. Sprinkle the blackened seasoning evenly over both sides of the patties, pressing it lightly into the surface so it adheres.
Cook the burgers. Heat a grill or cast iron skillet over medium-high heat and lightly oil (or butter) the surface. Once hot, add the patties and cook for about 3–4 minutes per side, or until a dark, flavorful crust forms and the burgers reach your desired doneness. Let rest for a few minutes.
Toast the buns. Toast the brioche buns until golden and lightly crisp.
Assemble. Spread a generous layer of blue cheese sauce on the bottom buns. Add the burgers, then top with crispy bacon, a handful of arugula, and a layer of thinly sliced red onion.
Serve. Serve immediately with fries or chips — and plenty of napkins.

https://www.gimmesomeoven.com/lemony-che.description: This Lemony Cherry Tomato Pasta is a quick and easy dinner made with juicy sautéed cherry tomatoes, garlic, and a bright finish of fresh lemon juice and zest.

ingredients: 4 large cloves garlic (pressed or finely minced)
1/4 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes (or more/less to taste)
1 teaspoon fine sea salt (plus more to taste)
2 tablespoons lemon juice + zest of 1 lemon
optional garnishes: chopped fresh basil (freshly-grated Parmesan, extra black pepper)
4 large cloves garlic (pressed or finely minced)
1/4 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes (or more/less to taste)
1 teaspoon fine sea salt (plus more to taste)
2 tablespoons lemon juice + zest of 1 lemon
optional garnishes: chopped fresh basil (freshly-grated Parmesan, extra black pepper)
https://www.gimmesomeoven.com/lemony-che.instructions:
Prep the pasta water. Bring a large pot of generously salted water to a boil.
Sauté the aromatics. Meanwhile, heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Stir in the garlic, tomato paste, red pepper flakes and cook for 2 minutes, stirring frequently, until fragrant.
Cook the pasta and start the sauce. Add the cherry tomatoes, salt, and a few twists of black pepper to the skillet and stir briefly to combine. At the same time, add the pasta to the boiling water and cook until just shy of al dente. Cook the tomato sauce for 8 to 10 minutes, stirring every few minutes as the tomatoes begin to cook down. Reserve about 3/4 cup of the starchy pasta water before draining the pasta.
Toss the pasta. Add the drained pasta to the skillet, along with a few splashes of reserved pasta water. Toss until the pasta is glossy and evenly coated, adding more pasta water as needed so the sauce lightly clings to the pasta.
Finish and serve. Remove from heat and toss with the lemon zest and juice. Taste and season with additional salt, black pepper, or red pepper flakes as needed. Serve warm, garnished with basil, Parmesan, and/or extra black pepper if you’d like. Enjoy!

https://fitslowcookerqueen.com/slow-cook.description: Slow cooker Georgia pot roast is a flavorful twist on the popular Mississippi roast. Instead of pepperoncini, this version uses pickled red onions which add a tangy and slightly sweet flavor. This healthier pot roast recipe skips the store-bought ranch and au jus packets in favor of simple homemade seasoning blends. The result is a comforting pot roast made with everyday ingredients. Instructions to make Georgia pot roast in the Instant Pot are also included.

ingredients: 12 ounces pickled red onions with their juices

1 1/2 tablespoons au jus gravy (see below for homemade)

Cook HIGH for 4 to 5 hours or LOW 8 to 9.
Remove beef from slow cooker. Shred the meat and place back into the slow cooker until ready to serve.
Instant Pot
Turn the Instant Pot to sauté. Once hot, add the oil and the beef. Cook 3-5 minutes on each side or until beef is browned. You may need to cut the beef to make the meat fit.
Remove beef from the Instant Pot. Pour in beef broth and deglaze the bottom of the pressure cooker by scraping the bits off with a wooden spoon.
Add the beef back to the pot. In a small bowl, mix together the homemade dry ranch & homemade au jus gravy. Pour the mixture on top of the beef. Pour the jar of red picked onions on top with their juices. Top with the butter.
Close lid and seal valve. Set high pressure for 60 minutes . When cooking time is complete, let the pressure release naturally for 10 minutes then quick release any remaining pressure.
Remove beef. Shred the meat and place back into the Instant Pot until ready to serve.

https://www.gimmesomeoven.com/lemon-pepp.instructions:
Make the marinade. In a medium bowl, whisk together the lemon zest, lemon juice, olive oil, Dijon mustard, honey, garlic, sea salt, black pepper and onion powder until combined.
Marinate the chicken. Add the chicken thighs to a large bowl or zip-top bag. Pour the marinade over the chicken and toss until evenly coated. Cover or seal and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes, or up to 8 hours.
Heat the grill. Preheat the grill to medium-high heat, around 400°F. Clean and oil the grill grates.
Grill the chicken. Remove the chicken thighs from the marinade, letting any excess drip off, and discard the remaining marinade. Place the chicken on the grill and cook for 5 to 7 minutes per side, with the lid closed between flips, until the chicken is nicely charred and cooked through.

https://www.gimmesomeoven.com/beer-brais.description: This beer-braised pulled pork recipe is made with tender pork shoulder, a smoky-sweet dry rub, and a savory beer braise for juicy, fall-apart pulled pork that’s perfect for sandwiches, tacos, bowls, nachos, and more.

ingredients: 4 pounds boneless pork shoulder (cut into 3-inch pieces)
1 (12-ounce) bottle beer (lager, amber, or pale ale)
2 teaspoons each: black pepper, garlic powder, onion powder
1 teaspoon each: chili powder, ground cumin, ground mustard
4 pounds boneless pork shoulder (cut into 3-inch pieces)
1 (12-ounce) bottle beer (lager, amber, or pale ale)
2 teaspoons each: black pepper, garlic powder, onion powder
1 teaspoon each: chili powder, ground cumin, ground mustard
https://www.gimmesomeoven.com/beer-brais.instructions:
Prep the pork. Pat the pork shoulder dry with paper towels. In a small bowl, whisk together all of the dry rub ingredients. Rub the mixture evenly all over the pork, pressing it firmly into the meat so it adheres.
Sear the pork (optional but recommended). Heat 1 tablespoon neutral oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat. Add the pork and sear for 2–3 minutes per side until nicely browned.
Add the cooking liquid. Pour in the beer and apple cider vinegar, and use a wooden spoon to scrape all of the browned bits off of the bottom of the pot. Stir in the Worcestershire sauce and liquid smoke (if using). The liquid should come about 1 inch up the sides of the pork.
Cook low and slow. Cover and cook at 300°F for 3½ to 4 hours, until the pork is fall-apart tender and easily shreds with a fork.
Shred the pork. Transfer the pork to a cutting board and shred with two forks, discarding any large pieces of fat.
Reduce the cooking liquid (only if needed). If the remaining cooking liquid already seems slightly thick and concentrated, you can skip this step. (Different pots will allow different amounts of liquid to evaporate while cooking!) If it seems brothy and thin, I recommend reducing it slightly. While the pork rests, bring the cooking liquid to a simmer over medium-high heat and cook for 8–10 minutes, until slightly reduced and concentrated in flavor.
Finish the pork. Return the shredded pork to the pot and toss with enough of the reduced cooking liquid to make it juicy and flavorful.
Serve. Serve warm, drizzled with BBQ sauce if desired, and enjoy!

https://www.gimmesomeoven.com/dads-vanil.description: This homemade vanilla ice cream recipe is an old-fashioned custard-style dessert that churns up wonderfully rich, smooth, and creamy.
https://www.gimmesomeoven.com/dads-vanil.instructions:
Whisk the eggs, sugar and salt. In a medium mixing bowl, whisk together the sugar, eggs and fine sea salt until smooth and slightly pale.
Warm the milk. In a medium saucepan, heat the whole milk over medium heat until it is steaming but not boiling.
Temper the eggs. While whisking constantly, slowly drizzle about 1 cup of the hot milk into the egg mixture until combined. Then slowly pour the tempered egg mixture back into the saucepan with the remaining milk, whisking constantly.
Cook the custard. Continue cooking the mixture over medium-low heat, stirring often, until it thickens slightly and coats the back of a spoon, about 5 to 8 minutes. Do not let it boil.
Add the cream and vanilla. Remove the pan from the heat. Stir in the heavy whipping cream and vanilla extract until combined.
Chill. Pour the mixture through a fine-mesh strainer into a clean bowl or container. Cover and refrigerate until completely chilled, at least 4 hours or overnight.
Churn. Churn the ice cream in an ice cream maker according to the manufacturer’s instructions, until thick and creamy.
Freeze. Transfer the ice cream to a freezer-safe container, cover, and freeze for at least 2 to 4 hours, or until firm enough to scoop. Serve and enjoy!!

https://www.gimmesomeoven.com/lemony-zuc.description: This crispy zucchini spaghetti features golden fried zucchini melted into a silky Parmesan sauce with lemon, basil and a pinch of red pepper flakes, inspired by classic spaghetti alla Nerano.

ingredients: 1 ½ cups neutral oil or olive oil (for frying)
2 large cloves garlic (peeled and lightly smashed)
¼ teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes (or more to taste)
1 teaspoon lemon zest + 2 tablespoons freshly-squeezed lemon juice
⅔ cup freshly-grated Parmesan (plus extra for serving)
¼ cup fresh basil leaves (torn, plus extra for serving)
fine sea salt and freshly-ground black pepper
1 ½ cups neutral oil or olive oil (for frying)
2 large cloves garlic (peeled and lightly smashed)
¼ teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes (or more to taste)
1 teaspoon lemon zest + 2 tablespoons freshly-squeezed lemon juice
⅔ cup freshly-grated Parmesan (plus extra for serving)
¼ cup fresh basil leaves (torn, plus extra for serving)
fine sea salt and freshly-ground black pepper
https://www.gimmesomeoven.com/lemony-zuc.instructions:
Slice the zucchini. Thinly slice the zucchini into rounds, ideally about ⅛-inch thick or slightly thinner. A mandoline is very helpful here so the slices cook evenly.
Heat the oil. Add the frying oil to a large sauté pan or skillet; you want enough oil to generously coat the bottom of the pan by about ½ inch. Heat over medium to medium-high heat until the oil reaches 350°F to 365°F. If you don’t have a thermometer, add one zucchini slice to the oil — it should immediately sizzle steadily.
Fry the zucchini. Working in batches so the pan is not crowded, add a single layer of zucchini slices to the hot oil. Fry for 2 to 4 minutes, flipping or stirring occasionally, until the zucchini are tender and lightly golden. Some slices may become more deeply golden than others, which is great, but avoid letting them turn dark brown or bitter.
Drain and season. Use a slotted spoon or spider strainer to transfer the fried zucchini to a paper-towel-lined plate. Sprinkle lightly with salt. Repeat with the remaining zucchini, adjusting the heat as needed to keep the oil around 350°F. Add a little more oil if the pan gets too dry.
Let the zucchini rest. This step is optional but very helpful: let the fried zucchini sit for at least 30 minutes, or refrigerate it for a few hours. It softens as it rests, which helps it melt beautifully into the sauce.
Cook the pasta. Bring a large pot of generously-salted water to a boil. Cook the spaghetti until just shy of al dente. Before draining, reserve at least 1 cup of the starchy pasta water.
Infuse the oil. While the pasta is cooking, heat the extra-virgin olive oil in a large skillet or Dutch oven over medium heat. Add the smashed garlic and cook for 1 to 2 minutes, until fragrant. Add the crushed red pepper flakes and cook for 30 seconds, then remove and discard the garlic.
Build the zucchini sauce. Add the fried zucchini to the skillet along with a generous splash of the starchy pasta water. Once the spaghetti is just barely al dente, add it to the skillet, along with the lemon zest, lemon juice, Parmesan, and basil. Toss quickly and continuously, adding more pasta water as needed, until the cheese melts into a silky sauce. Season with black pepper and additional salt, lemon juice, or crushed red pepper flakes to taste.
Serve. Serve immediately, topped with extra basil, Parmesan, black pepper, and an extra sprinkle of lemon zest if you’d like, and enjoy!!

https://www.gimmesomeoven.com/pesto-past.description: This easy pesto pasta with blistered cherry tomatoes and creamy burrata is a fresh, flavorful 30-minute dinner that is perfect for summer entertaining or busy weeknights.

ingredients: optional toppings: freshly-grated Parmesan, balsamic glaze, or chopped fresh basil
2 pints cherry or grape tomatoes (about 22 ounces)
½ teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes (or more/less to taste)
optional toppings: freshly-grated Parmesan, balsamic glaze, or chopped fresh basil
2 pints cherry or grape tomatoes (about 22 ounces)
½ teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes (or more/less to taste)
https://www.gimmesomeoven.com/pesto-past.instructions:
Cook the pasta. Bring a large pot of generously-salted water to a boil. Add the pasta and cook until just al dente. Just before draining, reserve 1 cup of the starchy pasta water, then drain the pasta.
Blister the tomatoes. Meanwhile, as the pasta water is heating, heat the olive oil in a large sauté pan over medium heat. Add the cherry tomatoes and cook for 7-10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the skins begin to blister and a few of the tomatoes just start to split, but most still hold their shape.
Add the garlic and crushed red pepper flakes. Stir in the garlic, crushed red pepper flakes, salt and black pepper. Cook for 1 minute, stirring often, until the garlic is fragrant. Remove the pan from the heat until the pasta is ready.
Toss the pasta. Combine the cooked pasta with the pesto and toss until evenly combined, adding splashes of reserved pasta water if needed to loosen the sauce until it’s glossy and coats the pasta. Add the cooked tomato mixture to the pasta and very gently toss to combine.
Serve. Transfer the pasta to serving bowls or a large platter. Tear the burrata over the top. Finish with any optional toppings you love — freshly-grated Parmesan, a drizzle of balsamic glaze and/or fresh basil leaves — then serve immediately and enjoy!

ingredients: 2 pounds boneless skinless chicken breasts or thighs
2 chipotle peppers in adobo sauce + 2 tablespoons of the adobo sauce
1 1/2 teaspoons fine kosher salt (or to taste)
2 pounds boneless skinless chicken breasts or thighs
2 chipotle peppers in adobo sauce + 2 tablespoons of the adobo sauce
1 1/2 teaspoons fine kosher salt (or to taste)
https://reciperunner.com/honey-chipotle-.instructions:
Combine all of the ingredients except the chicken in a glass measuring cup. Whisk together until well combined. Use a meat mallet to pound out the chicken so it's even in thickness.
Place the chicken in a freezer bag then pour in the marinade. Press the air out of the bag and seal it. Massage the marinade into the chicken. Refrigerate and marinate for at least an hour, 4-6 hours if you have the time.
Remove the chicken from the fridge 30 minutes before cooking it to bring it to room temperature.
Preheat the grill to 400° F. When the grill is hot, brush the grates until they're clean and coat them with cooking oil. Shake the excess marinade off of the chicken and place it on the grill.
Close the grill lid and cook for 6-8 minutes then flip the chicken and grill another 6-8 minutes or until the internal temperature reaches 160° F. The chicken will continue to cook to 165° F. as it rests.
Remove the chicken from the grill onto a plate and cover it loosely with foil and let it rest for 5-10 minutes before cutting and serving.

ingredients: Kosher salt and black pepper, (to taste)
2 tablespoons of the reserved pasta water
Kosher salt and black pepper, (to taste)
2 tablespoons of the reserved pasta water
https://www.twopeasandtheirpod.com/zucch.instructions:
Cook the Pasta. Bring a large pot of generously salted water to a boil. Cook the pasta according to package directions until al dente. Before draining, reserve 3/4 cup of the pasta cooking water. Drain the pasta and set aside.
Cook the Zucchini. While the pasta is cooking, heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add the zucchini and shallot. Season with salt and black pepper and cook, stirring occasionally, for 10 to 12 minutes, or until the zucchini is very soft and slightly caramelized. Stir in the garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Make the Zucchini Sauce. Transfer the zucchini mixture to a blender or food processor. Add the ricotta (or cottage cheese) and 2 tablespoons of the reserved pasta water to help it blend. Blend until smooth and creamy.
Combine the Pasta. Add the pasta back to the pot and pour the zucchini sauce over the pasta. Toss until well coated. Add 1/4 cup of the reserved pasta water to loosen the sauce and help it coat the pasta. Add more of the reserved pasta water, a tablespoon or two at a time, until the sauce reaches your desired consistency. You might not need it all.
Finish the Pasta. Stir in the Parmesan cheese, basil, lemon juice, and crushed red pepper flakes, if using. Season with additional salt and black pepper, to taste.
Serve. Serve immediately with extra Parmesan cheese and fresh basil, if desired.

https://www.twopeasandtheirpod.com/grill.description: Juicy citrus-marinated grilled steak topped with a fresh peach chimichurri made with herbs, garlic, lime, and ripe peaches. This easy summer dinner is perfect for cookouts, family dinners, and entertaining.

ingredients: 2 pounds skirt steak or flank steak
3 tablespoons olive oil or avocado oil
1/3 cup extra-virgin olive oil or avocado oil
Dash of crushed red pepper flakes
2 pounds skirt steak or flank steak
3 tablespoons olive oil or avocado oil
1/3 cup extra-virgin olive oil or avocado oil
Dash of crushed red pepper flakes
https://www.twopeasandtheirpod.com/grill.instructions:
Marinate the Steak: Place the flank steak in a large zip-top bag or shallow dish. In a medium bowl, whisk together the orange juice, lime juice, olive oil, apple cider vinegar, jalapeño, cilantro, green onions, garlic, maple syrup, cumin, chili powder, smoked paprika, oregano, salt, and black pepper. Pour the marinade over the steak, turning to coat both sides. Cover and refrigerate for 4 to 8 hours (don't marinate longer than 8 hours, as the citrus can affect the texture of the steak).
Make the Peach Chimichurri: In a medium bowl, stir together the cilantro, basil, mint, garlic, shallot, olive oil, lime juice, red wine vinegar, honey, salt, black pepper, and crushed red pepper flakes. Gently fold in the diced peach. Let the chimichurri sit at room temperature while you grill the steak so the flavors can meld.
Grill the Steak: Remove the steak from the marinade and let any excess drip off. Discard the remaining marinade. Preheat a grill to medium-high heat (about 450°F). Grill the steak for 4 to 6 minutes per side, or until it reaches your desired doneness (130 to 135°F for medium-rare or 140 to 145°F for medium).
Rest and Slice: Transfer the steak to a cutting board and let it rest for 10 minutes. Slice thinly against the grain.
Serve: Arrange the sliced steak on a serving platter and spoon the peach chimichurri over the top. Serve immediately.

https://www.budgetbytes.com/slow-cooker-.instructions:

1 yellow bell pepper (cut into large planks (stem and seeds removed))

Prepare the Salad:
In a large serving bowl, combine the slaw mix, cabbage, sliced scallions, nuts, cilantro, and mandarin oranges. Set aside while you cook the chicken.
Heat a large skillet over medium high heat and add the oil or ghee. Pat the chicken dry and season all over with the onion powder, garlic powder, salt and pepper.

Remove the chicken to a cutting board. Once it cools for 1-2 minutes, slice it or cut into bite size pieces. Arrange over the salad, then toss with as much dressing as you like, or, serve the dressing on the side if you prefer. Makes about 6 servings. Enjoy!

ingredients: 1 ½ tablespoons canola oil (or similar neutral cooking oil)
⅔ cup prepared salsa (plus additional for serving)
2 cups shredded sharp cheddar cheese (or Monterey Jack)
Nonstick spray (or butter, for crisping the burritos)

https://www.wellplated.com/bean-and-chee.instructions:
Soften
In a large skillet, heat the oil over medium-low. Sauté the onion until softened and turning golden, about 8 minutes.
Season
Stir in the salt, garlic powder, cumin, and black pepper, coating the onions.
Add one can of pinto beans with its liquid. Rinse and drain the second can of beans, then add to the pan. Add the water and salsa.
Simmer
Bring to a simmer over medium-high heat. With a potato masher or the back or a large spoon, lightly mash the beans and stir, leaving them as smooth or chunky as you like. Continue simmering, stirring often to prevent sticking, until the beans are thickened but spreadable, about 10 minutes. Taste and adjust the seasoning as you like.
Warm
To make the tortillas easier to roll, stack them on a plate, cover with a lightly damp paper towel, and microwave for 30 seconds.
Assemble the burritos: Down the center of each tortilla, sprinkle a 2 heaping tablespoons of cheese so it forms a line. Top with one-sixth of the mashed beans (about 1/2 cup). Add another 2 heaping tablespoons cheese on top. Fold the short sides of the tortillas over the filling to seal the ends, then lift one of the long sides up and over the filling, rolling to seal. Repeat with the remaining burritos.
Toast
When ready to eat, warm a medium nonstick skillet over medium heat. Lightly mist with nonstick spray (or melt a little butter in the skillet). Place a burrito in the skillet seamside down. Cook on each side until golden, 1 to 2 minutes per side. Let cool a few minutes, then slice and serve.

ingredients: 1½ lb. chicken thighs (boneless & skinless, (cut into 1-1.5 inch pieces) (680g) $5.58*)
1½ lbs. Yukon Gold potatoes (cut into 1-inch chunks, (about 4-5 medium potatoes) (680g) $1.59***)
1½ lb. chicken thighs (boneless & skinless, (cut into 1-1.5 inch pieces) (680g) $5.58*)
1½ lbs. Yukon Gold potatoes (cut into 1-inch chunks, (about 4-5 medium potatoes) (680g) $1.59***)
https://www.budgetbytes.com/bbq-chicken-.instructions:
Gather and preheat
Gather and prep ingredients. Preheat the grill to 425°F.
Prep the vegetables
Cut chicken thighs into bite-size pieces (about 1-1½ inches). Slice red onion and green bell pepper. Cut potatoes into 1-inch cubes.
Season the chicken
In a large bowl, combine the cubed chicken with ½ cup BBQ sauce, the vegetable oil, smoked paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, black pepper, and salt. Toss until evenly coated.
Add the veggies
Add the Yukon Gold potatoes, bell pepper, and onion to the bowl and toss until everything is lightly coated in the sauce.
Assemble the foil packs
Cut four 12x18-inch sheets of heavy-duty foil (see notes below). Divide the chicken and vegetable mixture evenly between the 4 foil packs, placing in the middle of the foil.
Fold the foil packs
Bringing the short sides of the foil together, fold the seams together twice and then tuck the ends in and up to seal tightly. Seal each packet tightly, leaving a little space inside for steam to circulate.
Grill or bake
Grill for 20-25 minutes, flipping once halfway through, until the chicken is cooked through (165℉ internally) and the potatoes are fork tender. (Or bake at 425°F for 25-30 minutes on a sheet pan in the oven until everything is fully cooked and tender.)
Finish and serve
Carefully open the packets, let the steam release, reglaze with remaining bbq sauce and serve immediately.

Preheat oven to 425°F and line a large baking sheet with parchment paper or foil.
Roast potatoes
Add the potatoes to a medium mixing bowl and toss with 1 Tablespoon olive oil, 1 teaspoon Italian seasoning, ½ teaspoon salt and ¼ teaspoon black pepper. Add to the prepared baking sheet and spread into an even layer and roast for 20 minutes, until they’re just starting to turn golden and tender.
Add
While the potatoes are roasting, add the zucchini, bell pepper, red onion and tomatoes to the same bowl you used for the potatoes.
Season
Drizzle with the remaining 1 Tablespoon olive oil and lemon juice, then add the garlic, remaining 1 teaspoon Italian seasoning, paprika, ½ teaspoon salt and ¼ teaspoon black pepper. Toss until everything is well coated.
Add
Remove the pan from the oven and carefully push the potatoes to one side. Spread the seasoned veggies onto the other side of the pan in an even layer.
Season salmon
Pat the salmon dry with paper towels and place the fillets on the pan. Sprinkle evenly with the remaining ½ teaspoon salt and a pinch of black pepper.
Bake salmon
Return the pan to the oven and bake for 12-15 minutes, or until the salmon flakes easily with a fork and the veggies are tender.
Make sauce
While salmon is cooking, make dill yogurt sauce by adding all the ingredients, except for the water to a small bowl and whisking until smooth and combined. Add water 1 Tablespoon at a time until you reach your desired consistency.
Add
Remove from the oven and top with olives, feta (if using) and fresh parsley. Add an extra squeeze of lemon, if desired.
Serve warm with dill yogurt sauce drizzled on top. Enjoy!

https://www.paleorunningmomma.com/easy-g.description: These Greek chicken zucchini boats are filled with rotisserie chicken, tomatoes, olives, fresh herbs, and feta, then finished with a creamy lemon-dill sauce. Using cooked chicken keeps the recipe manageable for a busy weeknight while still delivering plenty of fresh Greek-inspired flavor.

ingredients: Sea salt and freshly ground black pepper
1 cup cherry or grape tomatoes (roughly chopped)
1/2 teaspoon fine sea salt (plus more to taste)
1/2 cup dairy-free feta (or regular crumbed feta, divided)
1/2 cup avocado oil mayonnaise (paleo friendly if needed )
Sea salt and freshly ground black pepper (to taste)
Sea salt and freshly ground black pepper
1 cup cherry or grape tomatoes (roughly chopped)
1/2 teaspoon fine sea salt (plus more to taste)
1/2 cup dairy-free feta (or regular crumbed feta, divided)
1/2 cup avocado oil mayonnaise (paleo friendly if needed )

https://www.paleorunningmomma.com/easy-g.instructions:
First, prepare the zucchini. Preheat the oven to 400°F and line a large baking sheet with parchment paper. Cut each zucchini in half lengthwise. Use a small spoon or melon baller to scoop out the center of each zucchini half, leaving approximately a 1/4-inch border around the sides and bottom.
Roughly chop about 1 cup of the scooped-out zucchini flesh. Discard or save any remaining zucchini flesh for another use.
Arrange the hollowed zucchini halves cut-side up on the prepared baking sheet. Brush them lightly with about half of the avocado oil and season with salt and black pepper. Pre-bake the zucchini for 10 minutes. Remove from the oven and carefully blot away any excess moisture that has collected inside the boats.
While the zucchini pre-bakes, make the lemon-dill sauce. Whisk together the mayonnaise, lemon juice, lemon zest, garlic, dill, and parsley in a small bowl.
Season with salt and black pepper. Reserve about 1/4 cup of the sauce to add to the chicken mixture, then cover and refrigerate the sauce until ready to serve.
Heat the remaining avocado oil in a large skillet over medium heat to prepare the chicken filling. Add the diced red onion and the chopped zucchini flesh. Cook for 3 to 4 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the vegetables begin to soften.
Add the oregano, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, and black pepper. Stir and cook for about 30 seconds, until fragrant.
Add the rotisserie chicken, tomatoes, and olives. Cook for 2 to 3 minutes, stirring gently, until the chicken is warmed through and the tomatoes begin to soften slightly, then stir in the lemon juice, fresh parsley and fresh dill. Remove the skillet from the heat.
Fold 1/4 cup of the lemon dill sauce and 1/4 cup of the feta into the chicken filling. Taste the mixture and add additional salt, pepper, or lemon juice as needed.
Divide the chicken filling evenly among the pre-baked zucchini boats, gently pressing the mixture into each one. Sprinkle the remaining 1/4 cup feta over the tops.
Return the zucchini boats to the oven and bake for 12 to 15 minutes, or until the zucchini is tender but still firm enough to hold its shape.
To serve, drizzle the zucchini boats with the remaining creamy lemon-dill sauce and garnish with additional parsley, dill, tomatoes, olives, feta, and lemon wedges, if desired. Serve warm.

https://www.skinnytaste.com/creamy-pesto.description: This Creamy Pesto Pasta blends pesto with cottage cheese for a rich, creamy sauce with an extra boost of protein. It’s an easy weeknight pasta that comes together quickly with just a few ingredients.

ingredients: 12 ounces mezze rigatoni (or pasta shape of your choice (use gf pasta for gluten-free))
⅔ cup low-fat cottage cheese (I like Good Culture)
5 tablespoons parmesan cheese ( or Pecorino Romano grated, plus more optional for topping)
1 ½ tablespoons extra virgin olive oil
¼ teaspoon kosher salt (plus more to taste)
¼ teaspoon black pepper (plus more to taste)
12 ounces mezze rigatoni (or pasta shape of your choice (use gf pasta for gluten-free))

5 tablespoons parmesan cheese ( or Pecorino Romano grated, plus more optional for topping)
1 ½ tablespoons extra virgin olive oil
¼ teaspoon kosher salt (plus more to taste)
¼ teaspoon black pepper (plus more to taste)
https://www.skinnytaste.com/creamy-pesto.instructions:
Bring a large pot of generously salted water to boil.
Add the cottage cheese to a small blender with 2 tablespoons water, and process for about 15 seconds until smooth. Set aside.
Add garlic cloves to the food processor. Turn on for 15 to 30 secs until minced. Add the basil and continue processing until finely chopped. Add 3 to 4 tablespoons water, parmesan cheese, olive oil, lemon juice, salt, and pepper. Process until smooth throughout.
Once the pot is boiling, cook the pasta al dente, according to package directions. About 1 minute before draining, remove 1/2 cup pasta water and set aside. Drain the rest and pour the pasta back into the pot, remove from heat, let sit 2 minutes off the heat to prevent the sauce from breaking.
Pour in the pesto and stir, then the cottage cheese and stir well, until no streaks remain and the sauce and pasta are coated throughout.
If you would like the sauce any thinner, you may add reserved pasta water 1 tablespoon at a time until it reaches your desired consistency.
Top off with extra grated parmesan cheese, fresh basil leaves, and some extra salt and cracked black pepper, if desired.

https://www.spendwithpennies.com/stuffed.description: Chicken, peppers, onions, and spinach are added to a creamy sauce and baked in portobello mushroom caps with cheese.

ingredients: ¼ cup finely diced red bell pepper
2 cups cooked chopped chicken (or 14 oz diced artichokes)
5 ounces frozen chopped spinach (thawed and squeezed dry)
½ teaspoon black pepper (or to taste)
¼ cup finely diced red bell pepper
2 cups cooked chopped chicken (or 14 oz diced artichokes)
5 ounces frozen chopped spinach (thawed and squeezed dry)
½ teaspoon black pepper (or to taste)
https://www.spendwithpennies.com/stuffed.instructions:
Preheat oven to 425°F. Grease a rimmed baking sheet.
Prepare the portobello mushrooms by removing the stems and scraping out the gills on the underside. Discard the gills.
Brush both sides of the mushrooms with 2 tablespoons of olive oil and place them cap-side down on the prepared baking sheet. Roast for 10 minutes.
Meanwhile, finely chop the mushroom stems. In a non-stick skillet, heat 1 teaspoon of olive oil over medium heat. Add the onion, garlic, mushroom stems, and red bell pepper. Cook until tender, approximately 5 minutes.
In a medium bowl combine cream cheese and sour cream with a hand mixer until fluffy. Fold in the cooked onion mixture, chicken (or diced artichokes), spinach, ½ cup mozzarella cheese, and parmesan cheese. Season with salt and pepper.
Flip the mushrooms over and fill with the chicken mixture. Top with the remaining ½ cup of mozzarella cheese.
Bake for 12-16 minutes or until heated through and the cheese is browned.

Add olive oil to the pan and saute garlic and onions about 2 minutes. Return the meat to the pan, add tomatoes, basil, salt and pepper. Simmer on low for at least 30-40minutes, covered. Do not add extra water, the sauce should be thick.
Meanwhile, slice zucchini into 1/8" thick slices, add lightly salt and set aside or 10 minutes. Zucchini has a lot of water when cooked, salting it takes out a lot of moisture. After 10 minutes, blot excess moisture with a paper towel.
Preheat a gas grill or grill pan to medium high, and grill 2 to 3 minutes per side, until slightly browned. Place on paper towels to soak any excess moisture.
Preheat oven to 375F.
In a medium bowl mix ricotta cheese, parmesan cheese and egg. Stir well.
In a 9x12 casserole spread 1/2 cup of sauce on the bottom and layer the zucchini to cover. Spread 1/2 cup of the ricotta cheese mixture, then top with 1 cup of the mozzarella cheese and repeat the process until all your ingredients are used up. The last layer top with remaining zucchini and sauce, cover with foil and bake 30 minutes. Uncover the foil and bake 20 minutes (to dry up the sauce) then place the remaining 1 cup mozzarella and bake until melted, 10 minutes.
Let stand about 5 - 10 minutes before serving.

Photos above show a double batch, so please check the weight of the chicken you purchase to see how much marinade you'll need to make.

https://www.gimmesomeoven.com/my-favorit.instructions:
Prep the chicken. If using chicken breasts, pound them to an even thickness (about ¾-inch thick) for more even cooking. Pat the chicken dry with paper towels.
Make the marinade. In a medium bowl or jar, whisk together the olive oil, lemon juice, soy sauce, garlic, salt, pepper, smoked paprika, onion powder, and honey until well combined.
Marinate. Add the chicken to a large bowl or zip-top bag and pour the marinade over it. Toss until the chicken is evenly coated. Cover and refrigerate for 30 minutes to 2 hours.

Serve. Slice and serve warm with your favorite sides, or use in salads, bowls, wraps, tacos, and more.

Season the rice. Stir together the rice vinegar, sugar, and salt until dissolved. Gently fold into the warm rice. Let it cool slightly while you prep the rest.
Prep the salmon. Cut the salmon into 1-inch cubes and transfer to a bowl. Toss with soy sauce, sesame oil, garlic powder, and black pepper until evenly coated.

Toss the veggies. In a small bowl, toss the cucumbers and green onions with 1–2 teaspoons soy sauce until lightly coated.
Assemble the bowls. Divide the rice between bowls. Top with warm salmon, soy-tossed cucumber mixture, and avocado.
Finish and serve. Drizzle generously with spicy mayo and sprinkle with furikake. Add any extra toppings you love (chili crisp, pickled ginger, extra sriracha, etc). Serve immediately with soy sauce and enjoy!

https://www.paleorunningmomma.com/smash-.description: These easy smash burgers have irresistibly crispy edges, juicy centers, and the BEST creamy pickle burger sauce. Serve them on gluten-free buns or crisp lettuce wraps for a quick, protein-packed dinner with an easy paleo option.

ingredients: 1 tablespoon avocado oil (for frying the patties)
4 paleo-friendly burger buns (lettuce wraps, or toasted grain-free buns)
1 tablespoon avocado oil (for frying the patties)
4 paleo-friendly burger buns (lettuce wraps, or toasted grain-free buns)
https://www.paleorunningmomma.com/smash-.instructions:
Make the burger sauce. Whisk together the mayonnaise, ketchup, mustard, chopped pickles, pickle juice, garlic powder, onion powder, smoked paprika, and salt. Refrigerate while you prepare the burgers. Making it first gives the flavors a few minutes to blend.
Portion the beef. Divide the beef into 8 equal portions, about 2 1/2 ounces each. Very gently roll each portion into a loose ball.
The important part: do not pack the beef tightly. Loosely formed beef gives you those irregular, crispy edges when smashed.
Combine the salt, pepper, garlic powder, and onion powder in a small bowl. Don't mix the seasoning into the meat—I would season the outside once the beef hits the skillet. This keeps the texture tender and makes the recipe much faster.
Get the pan extremely hot. Heat a large cast-iron skillet or griddle over medium-high to high heat until very hot. A drop of water should sizzle immediately.
If your beef is 85/15 and your cast iron is well seasoned, you probably won't need oil. Otherwise, wipe the skillet with a very thin layer of avocado oil.
Smash the burgers. Working in batches so the pan isn't crowded, place 2–4 beef balls in the skillet, leaving several inches between them.
Immediately place a square of parchment over each ball and press very firmly with a burger press or sturdy spatula until the patty is about 1/4 inch thick.
Peel off the parchment and generously sprinkle the patties with the seasoning mixture.
Cook for about 2 minutes, until the edges look deeply browned and crisp and juices begin pooling on top.
Scrape and flip. Use a thin, sturdy spatula to firmly scrape underneath each patty so you keep all the browned crust attached.
Flip and cook for another 45-60 seconds. If you're using cheese, add it immediately after flipping. Stack two patties together for each burger.
Assemble. Spread burger sauce generously over the bottom bun. Add shredded lettuce, the double smash patties, pickles, onion, tomato if using, and another spoonful of sauce. Serve immediately and enjoy!

https://www.gimmesomeoven.com/jalapeno-c.description: This easy jalapeño cheddar cornbread is made with brown butter, sharp cheddar and fresh jalapeños for a moist, flavorful twist on classic cornbread.

ingredients: 1 cup (4 ounces) freshly grated sharp cheddar cheese
1 to 2 fresh jalapeños (seeded and finely diced)
1 cup (4 ounces) freshly grated sharp cheddar cheese
1 to 2 fresh jalapeños (seeded and finely diced)
https://www.gimmesomeoven.com/jalapeno-c.instructions:
Prep the oven and skillet. Heat oven to 400°F (200°C). Add the butter to a 9- or 10-inch cast-iron skillet, then place the skillet in the oven.
Brown the butter. While you prepare the batter, let the butter melt and simmer in the oven until lightly browned and nutty-smelling, watching closely so it doesn’t burn. Carefully remove the skillet from the oven. Swirl the butter to coat the sides of the skillet, then pour the browned butter into a heatproof bowl and set aside. (Leave the skillet greased and ready.)
Combine the dry ingredients. In a large mixing bowl, whisk together the flour, cornmeal, baking powder, baking soda, and salt until evenly combined.
Combine the wet ingredients. In a separate bowl, whisk together the eggs and honey until smooth. Add the buttermilk and whisk until combined.
Finish the batter. Make a well in the center of the dry ingredients and pour in the buttermilk mixture. Gently whisk until just combined. Add the browned butter and stir until incorporated, being careful not to overmix. Fold in the cheddar cheese and diced jalapeños just until evenly distributed.
Bake. Carefully pour the batter into the hot cast-iron skillet. Bake for 20–25 minutes, until golden on top and a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean.
Cool and serve. Transfer the skillet to a wire rack and let the cornbread cool for at least 10 minutes. Slice and serve warm.

https://reciperunner.com/zucchini-corn-o.instructions:
Add the olive oil to a large skillet or Dutch oven. Heat the oil over medium-high heat and when it's hot add in the shallot, zucchini, and corn. Season with salt and pepper and cook for 4-5 minutes or until the vegetables are tender.
Add the garlic and orzo into the skillet. Stir everything together and toast the orzo for a minute. Pour in the broth and bring it to a boil. Once boiling turn the heat down to medium-low or low, just so the orzo is simmering.

Cook the turkey

https://pinchofyum.com/crispy-parmesan-c.description: Crispy golden parmesan chicken atop creamy, luscious, lemony pasta! This combo is everything!

ingredients: 8 ounces pasta (I love mafalda for this, about half the box)
1/2 teaspoon Better Than Bouillon chicken base
zest of half of a lemon
a handful of fresh basil leaves, cut into fine ribbons
an easy green salad for serving
8 ounces pasta (I love mafalda for this, about half the box)
1/2 teaspoon Better Than Bouillon chicken base
zest of half of a lemon
a handful of fresh basil leaves, cut into fine ribbons
an easy green salad for serving
https://pinchofyum.com/crispy-parmesan-c.instructions:
Prep the Chicken
Preheat the oven to 425 degrees and line a baking sheet with parchment. Cut each chicken breast into thin, flat pieces (not bite-sized but something that looks like a thin chicken breast). For example: if a one-pound package gives me two chicken breasts, I’m often cutting it into 3-4 thin pieces per breast. Thin chicken is essential! And delicious! Pat the chicken breasts dry if they have a lot of moisture on them.
Prep Topping
Mix the parmesan, panko, Italian seasoning, paprika, garlic powder, and salt in a bowl.
Coat the Chicken
Place mayo in a bowl. Brush each chicken piece to coat with a thin layer of mayo. Spoon the panko mixture evenly over each piece of chicken. Press firmly to adhere the crumbs to the chicken, getting it as well-coated as you can. Carefully flip chicken pieces over and repeat on the other side. Finally, spray the top side with avocado oil spray until coated. (You will have some crumbles remaining on the baking sheet – that’s fine.)
Bake the Chicken
Bake for 13-15 minutes, or until the chicken looks golden. Turn on the broiler; broil for 1-2 minutes. Grab each piece along the sides with tongs, flip, and broil the back side so it gets very golden and crispy all around and reaches an internal temp of 165.
Make the Lemon Sauce
Melt butter over medium low heat. Add garlic; sauté for 2-3 minutes. Add flour; sauté for another 2-3 minutes. It will bubble and get a bit foamy.
Finish Sauce
Add cream, water, and Better than Bouillon. Simmer for about 10 minutes until the sauce has thickened and clings to the back of a spoon. Remove the sauce from heat to cool slightly. Stir in the lemon zest and lemon juice.
Cook the Pasta
Cook pasta according to package directions. When draining, reserve a bit of pasta water. Add the pasta to the sauce and toss to combine. Add reserved pasta water as needed.
Serve
Slice your crispy chicken into strips. Scoop the hot, saucy pasta into shallow bowls, place the chicken slices on top, and finish with the basil ribbons. Sometimes I like to grab the extra crumbles from the sheet pan and sprinkle them on top, and serve with a lemon wedge. OOOOH BABY!

Gather and prep
Gather your ingredients.
Make the marinade
Prepare the marinade first. Stir together the soy sauce, brown sugar, water, garlic, ginger, and 1 Tbsp of the cooking oil in a bowl.***
Marinate the chicken
Place the chicken in a shallow bowl or dish, then pour the marinade over top. Turn the chicken a couple of times to make sure it's well coated. Let the chicken marinate for 30 minutes to one day (refrigerated), turning the chicken occasionally as it marinates.****
Heat the oil

Cook the chicken for about 5-7 minutes on each side or until cooked through (175℉ internally) and the liquid in the skillet has reduced to a light coating of glaze on the chicken.
Rest and serve
Transfer the chicken to a cutting board and let it rest for about 5 minutes before slicing and serving.

ingredients: 6 to 7 cups chicken broth (or vegetable broth) (divided)
2 tablespoons neutral oil (avocado, canola, or vegetable oil)
7 ounces fideo pasta (or vermicelli broken into 1-inch pieces)
toppings: chopped fresh cilantro, crumbled cotija cheese, lime wedges or sliced avocado

Blend the tomato base. In a blender, combine the diced tomatoes (with their juices), onion, garlic, and 1 cup of the broth. Blend until completely smooth. Set aside.
Toast the fideo. Heat the oil in a medium saucepan over medium heat. Add the dry fideo and cook, stirring frequently, until deeply golden and fragrant, about 3–5 minutes. Keep a close eye — the noodles can burn quickly.
Build the soup. Carefully pour the blended tomato mixture into the pot with the toasted fideo. (It will bubble up, so be careful!) Stir and cook for 2–3 minutes to slightly concentrate the flavor. Finish. Remove and discard the cilantro and bay leaf. Add an additional cup of broth if you would like a brothier soup. Taste and add additional salt if needed.
Serve. Ladle into bowls, add your favorite toppings, serve warm and enjoy!

ingredients: 2 bone-in pork chops (1 ½ inches thick, 12 ounces each)
½ teaspoon dried thyme leaves (or 1 ½ teaspoons fresh)
½ teaspoon dried rosemary (or 1 ½ teaspoons fresh)
2 bone-in pork chops (1 ½ inches thick, 12 ounces each)

https://www.spendwithpennies.com/pan-sea.instructions:
Combine butter, thyme, and rosemary in a small bowl. Set aside.
Dab pork chops dry with a paper towel and generously season with kosher salt and pepper.
Heat oil in a large skillet or pan (cast iron is best) over medium-high heat.
Add pork chops and sear for 2 minutes or until golden brown. Flip the chop over and sear for 2 minutes until browned.
Reduce the heat to medium and continue to cook the chops until they reach 138-140°F in the thickest part of the pork chop, about 6 to 8 minutes more, turning as needed.

Spoon the butter from the pan over chops and serve.

https://www.spendwithpennies.com/easy-sp.description: This homemade Spinach Lasagna is cheesy & budget-friendly, it's the perfect dish to feed a crowd!
https://www.spendwithpennies.com/easy-sp.instructions:
Preheat oven to 350°F. Line a 9x13 pan with Reynolds Wrap® Heavy Duty Foil.
Place lasagna noodles in a pan and cover with boiling water for 15 minutes. Rinse with cold water and dab dry.
Meanwhile, heat olive oil over medium heat in a large skillet. Add onion and garlic and cook until tender, about 5 minutes. Add pasta sauce and Italian seasoning. Simmer 5 minutes more or until slightly thickened.
While sauce is simmering, squeeze spinach to remove moisture. Combine with ricotta cheese, 2 ½ cups mozzarella cheese, ¼ cup parmesan cheese, egg, fresh parsley, and salt. Mix well.
Place 1 cup of sauce in the bottom of the prepared pan.
Layer with 3 lasagna noodles. Add ½ of the spinach and cheese mixture and ⅓ of the sauce.
Add 3 more lasagna noodles, remaining ½ of the spinach and cheese mixture, and ⅓ of the sauce. Top with the last 3 noodles and the remaining sauce.
Cover with Reynolds Wrap® Heavy Duty Foil to ensure it is well sealed and bake 45 minutes. Remove foil, top with remaining mozzarella and parmesan cheese. Bake an additional 15-20 minutes or until browned.
Cool 20 minutes before cutting.

https://www.budgetbytes.com/sheet-pan-do.description: This Sheet Pan Doner Kebab is an easy oven shortcut for thin, crispy beef served gyro-style in soft pita with tzatziki and fresh vegetables.
https://www.budgetbytes.com/sheet-pan-do.instructions:
Gather and preheat
Gather and prepare all ingredients. Preheat the oven to 400°F.
Season the meat
In a medium bowl, add the ground beef, grated onion, garlic, dried oregano, cumin, paprika, salt, pepper, dried thyme, garlic powder, and onion powder.
Mix the meat
Using your hands or a rubber spatula, combine all the ingredients until fully incorporated and divide the mixture in half.
Roll in parchment
Place each half on a sheet of parchment paper, then fold in half. Using a rolling pin, roll the beef mixture out thin to the edges of the parchment paper. Continue with the other half.
Fold the meat
Fold each of the parchment papers with the meat into thirds and place on a sheet pan.
Cook in oven
Place the sheet pan in the preheated oven and cook for 15 minutes.
Make the sauce
While the meat is cooking, you can make the tzatziki. Grate and press the cucumber into a medium bowl. Discard the liquid. Then add the grated cucumber, Greek yogurt, garlic, dill, lemon juice, oil, salt, and pepper into the bowl. Stir to combine and set it aside.
Turn to broil
After 15 minutes, remove the sheet pan and turn the oven to broil.
Unwrap and shred
Carefully unwrap the beef from the parchment****. Using kitchen shears or your hands (when the meat has cooled enough), cut the beef into medium-sized pieces and place them back on the sheet pan.
Broil the meat
Place the pan back in the oven and broil for an additional 3 minutes until the edges of the beef are crispy. Make sure to keep an eye on it while it broils so it doesn’t burn.
Garnish and serve
Remove the sheet pan from the oven. Divide the meat evenly onto each pita. Drizzle on the tzatziki and top with your favorite veggies, then enjoy!

¾ cup frozen peppers and onions (5 oz., (half a bag) $0.78***)

Add the entire tube of ground beef and pork, breaking it up with a spatula as it cooks.
Cook the meat

Add pepperoni
Quarter the pepperoni slices and add them to the top of the pizza burgers (optional).
Bake and serve
Bake the pizza burgers until the cheese has melted and begun to toast on top, about 8-10 minutes. Enjoy!

ingredients: 1 ½ pounds Italian sausage (casing removed, or ground beef or turkey)
48 ounces marinara sauce (or spaghetti sauce, 2 jars, divided)
8 ounces cottage cheese ( or ricotta cheese)
chopped fresh parsley ( and parmesan cheese for garnish, optional)
1 ½ pounds Italian sausage (casing removed, or ground beef or turkey)

https://www.spendwithpennies.com/million.instructions:
Preheat the oven to 350°F. Grease a 9x13-inch baking dish.
Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Cook the pasta al dente according to package directions. Drain well and return the pasta to the original pot. Add 24 oz of prepared spaghetti sauce and toss to combine. Set aside.
In a large skillet, combine Italian sausage, onion, and garlic over medium-high heat. Cook until no pink remains and the onion is soft. Drain excess fat. Stir in the remaining 24 oz of spaghetti sauce and 2 teaspoons of Italian seasoning. Set aside.
In a medium mixing bowl, blend cottage cheese (or ricotta), cream cheese, sour cream, 1 cup mozzarella, and 1 teaspoon Italian seasoning using a hand mixer. Set aside.
Spread half of the spaghetti in the prepared baking dish, then top with the cottage cheese mixture. Spread the remaining spaghetti over the cheese mixture. Pour the meat sauce evenly over the top.
Bake uncovered 35-45 minutes, until the casserole is heated through, adding the mozzarella on top for the last 20 minutes of cook time.
Rest 15 minutes before serving.

https://www.gimmesomeoven.com/blueberry-.description: These soft, moist blueberry muffins are brightened with lemon zest and almond extract for the best bakery-style muffin recipe you'll make on repeat.
https://www.gimmesomeoven.com/blueberry-.instructions:
Prep the oven and muffin pan. Heat oven to 375°F. Line a 12-cup muffin pan with paper liners or lightly grease with nonstick spray.
Coat the blueberries. In a small bowl, gently toss the blueberries with 1 tablespoon of the flour until evenly coated. Set aside.
Mix the wet ingredients. Using a stand mixer or hand mixer, beat the softened butter and granulated sugar together on medium-high speed for 2 to 3 minutes, or until light and fluffy. Add the eggs one at a time, mixing well after each addition. Add the vanilla extract, almond extract and lemon zest, and mix until combined.
Add the dry ingredients and milk. Add the baking powder, sea salt and half of the remaining flour, and mix until just combined. Add the milk and mix until just combined. Add the remaining flour and mix until just combined, being careful not to over-mix.
Fold in the blueberries. Use a spatula to gently fold the flour-coated blueberries into the batter until evenly combined.
Bake. Divide the batter evenly among the prepared muffin cups, adding about ¼ cup batter to each. Sprinkle each muffin with sparkling sugar, if desired. Bake for 20 to 25 minutes, or until the muffins are lightly golden on top and a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean.
Cool. Let the muffins cool in the pan for about 5 minutes, then transfer them to a wire rack to cool completely. Serve and enjoy!

https://www.budgetbytes.com/lentil-burge.description: Skip the grill and make these easy Lentil Burgers in the oven. They’re hearty, totally vegan, and hold together with simple pantry ingredients!
https://www.budgetbytes.com/lentil-burge.instructions:
Preheat the oven
Gather and prepare all ingredients. Preheat the oven to 400°F.
Cook the lentils
Bring the water to a simmer in a medium pot. Once it’s simmering, add the lentils. Let the pot return to a simmer, then place a tilted lid on top. Allow the lentils to simmer for about 20 minutes. After 20 minutes, taste the lentils to test the texture. They should be tender but not mushy. Drain the lentils in a colander and rinse with cold water to cool.
Blend the lentils
Place 1¼ cups (about 240g) of the cooked lentils, garlic, tomato paste, salt, pepper, paprika, and cumin in the food processor. Blend until the ingredients are just combined and form a paste-like consistency, scraping down the sides as needed. Then place it into a large bowl.
Make burger mixture
Next, add the remaining cooked lentils, carrots, onions, and flour to the bowl. Fold to combine.
Make the patties
Divide the lentil mixture into 4 evenly sized patties, about ½-inch thick. Make sure to press them together firmly so they hold their shape***. Arrange the patties on a parchment-lined sheet tray coated with nonstick spray, then lightly spray the tops of the burgers as well.
Bake the burgers
Bake for about 15 minutes, then gently flip the patties over, and spray again with nonstick spray. Bake for about 15 more minutes.
Serve
Place the lentil burgers on buns with your favorite toppings and enjoy.

ingredients: 12 ounces fully cooked chicken sausage (sliced into coins)
½ teaspoon freshly ground black pepper
¼ cup chopped fresh dill (plus extra for topping)
12 ounces fully cooked chicken sausage (sliced into coins)
½ teaspoon freshly ground black pepper
¼ cup chopped fresh dill (plus extra for topping)
https://www.gimmesomeoven.com/one-pan-me.instructions:
Brown the sausage. Heat the olive oil in a large sauté pan over medium-high heat. Add the chicken sausage and cook for 6 to 8 minutes, stirring and flipping occasionally, until browned on both sides. Transfer the sausage to a clean plate and set aside.
Cook the zucchini. Add the zucchini to the same pan and cook for 4 to 5 minutes, stirring occasionally, until lightly golden.
Add the garlic and orzo. Stir in the garlic and cook for 30 seconds. Add the orzo and cook for another minute, stirring frequently, to lightly toast it.
Simmer. Add the chicken broth, oregano, and black pepper. Stir to combine. Bring to a simmer, then reduce the heat to medium-low (or whatever heat will maintain a low simmer) and cook, stirring often, for 9 to 11 minutes, or until the orzo is al dente and most of the broth has been absorbed.
Finish. Stir in the lemon zest, lemon juice, dill, and spinach. Cook for 1 minute, until creamy and the spinach is just wilted. Return the sausage to the pan and gently stir to combine.
Serve. Taste and season with additional salt, pepper, or lemon juice as needed. If the orzo seems too dry, you can also add in an extra splash of broth. Serve topped with feta, dill, a twist of black pepper, and enjoy!

This easy chicken dinner is packed with fresh flavor and perfect for summer grilling.

ingredients: Dash of crushed red pepper flakes

https://www.spendwithpennies.com/slow-co.description: This slow cooker whole chicken is rubbed with smoky herbs and cooked until tender and juicy. The seasoned drippings make a rich homemade gravy for an easy Sunday-style dinner.
https://www.spendwithpennies.com/slow-co.instructions:
Combine all seasoning mix ingredients in a small bowl.
Brush chicken with olive oil and rub seasoning into chicken.
Roll up balls of foil and place in the bottom of the slow cooker with 2 thick slices of onion. Place chicken on foil, breast side up so it is slightly lifted off the bottom of the slow cooker.
Cover and cook on low for 7 to 8 hours or high for 4 to 5 hours until the chicken reaches an internal temperature of 165℉.
Remove the chicken and place it in a small pan. Broil for 3 to 4 minutes to crisp the skin (optional). Rest for 10 minutes before slicing.
Gravy
Remove foil and onion from slow cooker and turn onto high. If required, add broth to create about 2 cups of liquid.
In a small bowl, combine 4 tablespoons cornstarch with 4 tablespoons water to create a slurry.
Whisk about ⅔ of the cornstarch into the drippings/broth and let cook on high. Depending on the amount of liquid you may need to add more of the cornstarch slurry to reach desired consistency. Let cook at least 5 minutes before serving.
Taste and season with salt & pepper.
